chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, he said:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: “The injuries of slaves are according to the manner of the injuries of free people in the value.”

key_terms.الثَّمَنِ: monetary value or price used as the basis of compensation

ai.seo_question: How are injuries to slaves compensated in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on compensation for injuries inflicted upon slaves. It states that their injuries are assessed in parallel to the injuries of free persons, with compensation measured in relation to their monetary value.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5269 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni, Commander of the Faithful (as) said:
"The injuries of slaves are to be compensated in the same manner as the injuries of free people, according to their value."
